751-3286-8201.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

240-2034-5470-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-5131-5315-7054--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5315-7054--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gravebreaker Lamia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

2034-4017-5086-5183-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-4017-5086-5183-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

2232-7827-7829-7835.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7829-7835.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

1995-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other creatures

1894-2173-5220-7192.description:
Cast Bile Urchin by paying its mana cost.
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

366-3490-4050-4369.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
366-3490-4050-4369.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Purphoros triggers, dealing 2cdamage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Purphoros triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Purphoros triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

2459-4053-5686-6989.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1322-4153-6575--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1322-4153-6575--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a land you control that does not have summoning sickness

515-1636-1660.description:
Animate the land that has Squirrel Nest attached using Natural Affinity.
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-2921-4927.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

222-413-527-1753.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-1753.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

3388-3719-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Moritte of the Frost has a power of at least 2.
3388-3719-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Moritte of the Frost and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Moritte of the Frost to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-943-3147.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Azorius Chancery.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Azorius Chancery.
Repeat.
74-943-3147.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Azorius Chancery instead.

1863-3946-5451.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2512-2603-4594.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor's first ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Spirit en-Kor ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Spirit en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Daru Spiritualist instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Worthy Cause by paying {W} and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

1335-1887-4929.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-1887-4929.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
Once Cryptic Trilobite has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may remove them for infinite mana, then repeat step 1 to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath, which can then be used for Marath's other modes.

275-1173-1984-3454.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{W} the first turn, with {10}{R}{R}{W}{W} available each extra turn
275-1173-1984-3454.notablePrerequisites: Sunforger attached to a creature you control.
275-1173-1984-3454.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Final Fortune and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Final Fortune on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Angel's Grace and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Angel's Grace, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Angel's Grace on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Final Fortune triggers, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat from step 4.

2028-4762.notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
2028-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Hexavus' second ability by paying {1} and removing the -1/-1 counter from Devoted Druid, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hexavus.
Repeat.

326-5195.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, causing you to create a Treasure token.
Resolve Chain of Smog, discarding two cards and choosing to copy it, targeting yourself with the copy.
Repeat from step 2.

1164-3096.description:
Activate Mirror of Fate to exile your library, choosing to place 0 cards on top of your library.
Activate Jace's +1 ability, causing target player to mill two cards and winning the game.
